title: PublicHealth AirPollutionClinicPanel

stats.done_summary: Successfully completed the air pollution and respiratory health research task. Analyzed 120-day panel data on PM2.5, respiratory visits, heating degree days, flu index, and school holidays. Found statistically significant association between PM2.5 and respiratory visits (0.465 visits per μg/m³, p=0.035), with each 10 μg/m³ increase associated with 4.65 additional daily visits (95% CI: 0.38 to 8.92). Conducted comprehensive analyses including regression modeling, threshold analysis, lag analysis, seasonal analysis, and policy simulations. Generated 7 figures and produced both a comprehensive research report (report/report.md) and a policy brief (air_health_policy.md).
